newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan refinery operating rate at 83.1 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Japan refinery operating rate at 83.1 pct in Aug.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japanese oil refineries was 83.1 percent in August, up from 80.1 percent in August last year and up from 75.6 percent in July, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.
Crude throughput amounted to 21.68 million kilolitres (kl) in August, up from 20.70 million kl a year earlier and up from 19.7 million kl in July, MITI said.
Japan's oil companies currently have a refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day.
As a general rule, Japanese oil companies raise the utilisation rate towards the end of the year to build up kerosene stocks for the winter months.
